name: SkeletonShimmer
description: Content placeholder blocks — an avatar, title lines, and body lines — with a soft shimmer band sweeping across every bar in sync.
a11yNotes: The wrapper is role="status" with aria-busy and a label (default "Loading content"); every bar is aria-hidden. Widths are deterministic so SSR markup matches the client. Under prefers-reduced-motion the shimmer stops and plain blocks remain.

propsApi.name: avatar
propsApi.description: Show the avatar and title block.
